jobs.title: Summer Recreation Intern - 2027
jobs.description: Title: Paid Summer Recreation Internship Dates of Employment - 8 to 10 Week Options Description: The Kenilworth Park District offers a quality internship program to students working toward a degree within the field of parks and recreation or related areas of study. The internship provides a comprehensive experience of district operations, including administration, programming, employee management, facility management, camps, historic properties,
